{{Top|leg}}
A '''navigational sensor''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Upon reversion to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], the navigational sensors scanned the local area for known navigational markers to determine the ship's position.
